_meta.purpose: Historical migration-tooling contract retained as pattern registry for future Rust/Buck2/native-SCM migration automation; not an active local CLI command contract.
_meta.retirement_note: The historical local dev migration and VCS claim/done surfaces are retired as agent/CI authorities. Preserve the structured migration planning pattern by rewriting it as Rust libraries, Buck2 targets, and native SCM service/Prow jobs; do not restore retired local VCS CLI authority.

command: retired; future surface is Rust library + Buck2 target + native SCM service job, not local dev CLI
implemented_by: retired CLI provenance; future implementation must be Rust/Buck2/native-SCM/Prow-owned
synopsis: retired; no sanctioned oya CLI synopsis

--microservice.description: kebab-case µservice name; matches ADR-0131 migration_ip_enumeration entries

--dry-run.description: Default: dry-run; emits the plan + the git-mv commands without executing. Pass --no-dry-run to execute.

--force.description: Skip pre-flight refusals (NOT recommended; logged with elevated severity in audit-chain).

--from-paths.description: Override default paths to migrate (e.g., only certain crates). Default: full per-µservice scope.

phases.name: 1-discover
phases.description: Enumerate every artifact owned by the µservice across the legacy locations.
actions: Find `registry/catalog/<crate>.yaml` rows for each owned crate
Find `contracts/openapi/<surface>/`, `contracts/asyncapi/<surface>/`, `contracts/<surface>.proto` where surface matches µservice ownership
Find `evidence/multispectrum/<change_id>-*.json` belonging to changesets that touched this µservice

phases.name: 2-pre-flight
phases.description: Refuse if conditions for safe migration are not met.

checks.rule: git working tree clean for the µservice's paths
checks.violation: uncommitted changes; commit or stash first

checks.rule: no other agent/native SCM worktree lease or PR lane owns these paths
checks.violation: concurrent lease/PR active; retry after that lane completes

checks.rule: target microservices/<ms>/ does NOT already exist (or --force used)
Cargo.toml [workspace.members] contains the legacy crate paths
no parallel-session PR touches the legacy paths
checks.violation: merge conflict risk; coordinate with parallel session

phases.name: 3-plan
phases.description: Emit the migration plan as a structured JSON.

rename_pkg.description: true if Cargo.toml package name rewrite needed (e.g., oya-check-* → oya-governance-*)

phases.name: 4-execute
actions: git mv per planned operation (preserves history)
Update each moved crate's Cargo.toml `[package].name` if renaming
Update path-dependencies in every other crate's Cargo.toml that references the moved crates
Update cross-references in *.md files (use ast-grep on Markdown-link patterns; never blanket-sed)
Regenerate aggregation indices (docs/prds/INDEX.md, registry/catalog aggregation, machine-readable views)
Emit single audit-chain seal: `microservice_migrated{microservice, files_moved, refs_updated, executed_at, signature}`

phases.name: 5-verify
phases.description: Run the verification set; refuse exit-0 unless all pass.
checks: buck2 uquery //... exits 0 (graph loads; no Cargo executable authority)
future Rust/Buck2 governance targets for per-microservice layout, cross-ref validity, and aggregation index generation exit 0 (no retired oya gate/verify CLI authority)
legacy paths inventory returns empty for the migrated µservice after the PR lands
git log --follow shows continuity for moved files (no broken history)

phases.name: 6-finalize
phases.description: Mark migration complete in the native SCM/worktree lease ledger and emit completion evidence; do not call oya vcs done.
actions: release the native SCM/worktree lease for migration-<ms>-<unix_ts>
open/merge the PR through the trusted oya-ci-required path after Buck2/Prow evidence is green
Emit MicroserviceMigrationCompleted event (consumed by audit-chain + DR-pair cluster mirror)

rollback.trigger: Verification phase failure OR explicit native SCM migration rollback request through the future Rust/Buck2/Prow migration job

idempotency: Re-running migrate-microservice on an already-migrated µservice is a no-op + emits a `migration_already_complete` audit event. The command does NOT mutate state when the target shape is already correct.
parallel_safety: Multiple migrations may run concurrently for different µservices when they touch disjoint paths. Running the same migration twice in parallel is prevented by native SCM/worktree lease records on `microservices/<ms>/**`, not by an oya vcs CLI claim.

large_microservice (foundry split: 6 sub.wall_time: ≤ 10min per sub-microservice; running in parallel: ≤ 15min total

governance bundle (50 oya-check-* crates.wall_time: ≤ 30min (atomic; long but bundleable as one ChangeSet)

verification_post_completion.expected_state: every migrated µservice conforms to ADR-0131 canonical folder shape
verification_post_completion.rollback_window: Migration commit may be reverted within 24h without ADR; after 24h, revert requires its own ADR-shaped decision.

references: feedback_rename_blanket_sed_forbidden — multi-batch migration required; this tool replaces blanket-sed with structured operations
